params.body:
One `curl -I` on `/webhook/image/1/processed` was an error page (Nightwatch 13, 31 August 2026): `DecryptException: The payload is invalid`. The first line of `processed` does `decrypt($image_id)`, outside the `try` underneath it, and `decrypt` throws on anything that is not a valid encrypted value.

This is the door Blurit reports back through, so it is open to the world and stays open during maintenance (R P3-12.1). An open door answers what knocks on it; what it may not do is fall over. The encrypted id is not a lock here but a reference: something that cannot be read points at no photo, so 404.

Same shape as the garbled showroom link of 20 September: a bare `decrypt()` on an address that comes from outside. That one was on `DealerController`, this one on the webhook.

- `R S1-6.9` extended; finding `onleesbaar-id-op-de-fotowebhook`, resolved here.
- `AnUnreadableWebhookIdIsNotFoundTest` with the boundary (a readable id still gets through, even when no photo carries it) and the real thing (the photo comes out of "processing"). Verified to bite: without the guard it fails with the exact production exception.

Full suite green, PHPStan clean.
params.title: An unreadable id on the photo webhook is not found
